name: tapetide
description: Indian stock market research for about 8,200 NSE and BSE listed companies: live quotes, quarterly and annual financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio fundamental screener, technical screens, analyst ratings, FII/DII flows, end-of-day index option chains with IV, parsed company filings, IPOs, and your Tapetide portfolio and watchlist. 55 tools. Free plan included. Research data, not investment advice.
